calls.title: Build overnight without waiting for plan approval
calls.chose: Wrote the one-page plan and built straight on
calls.because: Parker said use your own judgement and build end to end on the experimental branch, then went to sleep; the branch is unmerged
calls.undo: Revert the flyout commits on explore/t3-scuttle

calls.title: Tabs belong to the left-bar task they were opened in
calls.chose: Each task keeps its own flyout tabs; open/closed and width are the window's
calls.because: The flyout should follow the conversation, as T3's side panel follows its thread; a single global set piles up every project's diffs
passed_over: One set of tabs for the whole window
calls.undo: Move the tab list from Tab to Workspace

calls.title: A pull request handed over on the rail opens in the flyout
calls.chose: The rail's PR handover opens the PR tab instead of asking about the browser
calls.because: It is the agent's evidence and belongs beside its conversation; the browser stays one press away inside the tab

reasons: both readings are medium under a standard posture

calls.title: Draw diffs, files and PRs natively, not as a live page
calls.chose: Native gpui views fed by git and gh; a live Chromium page waits
calls.because: He asked for code files, diffs and PRs; native rows are faster, wear the theme and need no GitHub cookies in a browser profile
passed_over: A live Chromium tab over CDP, as the pasted assessment recommended
calls.undo: Add a page tab kind beside the three

calls.title: Ctrl+Shift+R and Alt+click open the flyout
calls.chose: Ctrl+Shift+R toggles it; Alt+click on a code file or PR URL opens there
calls.because: Ctrl+Shift+R is free everywhere in the code; Alt+click already means open inside TD and did nothing on those targets
passed_over: Changing Ctrl+click on PR URLs, which people already use for the browser
calls.undo: Drop the chord and the OpenSide intent

calls.title: Pull requests are read-only, from gh on PATH
calls.chose: gh pr view and gh pr diff; no merge, checkout or comment buttons
calls.because: Writes to GitHub are outward-facing and Parker has not asked for them; gh on PATH is what any user has, TD_GH overrides it
passed_over: T3's Merge and Check out buttons

calls.title: The Changes tab re-reads git every three seconds while shown
calls.chose: Poll only the visible tab: changes 3s, a file on change, PR 60s
calls.because: Agents edit while you watch; polling only what is on screen keeps twenty panes cheap
